profiles.name: Mephling
speciesTraits: Small Humanoid with −2 Intelligence, +2 Charisma, and a 30-ft. land speed. A Mephling gains the Extraplanar subtype away from its own ancestral Elemental Plane. It has no elemental subtype.
Small size gives +1 AC and attack rolls, +4 Hide, and three-quarters of the normal lifting and carrying limits for its Strength. It uses Small weapons.

Breath Weapon. A 15-ft. cone deals 1d8 damage to each target, Reflex half (DC 10 + half the Mephling’s Hit Dice + its Constitution modifier). One use per day, plus one per four levels attained. With multiple daily uses, wait 1d4 rounds between uses. The core breath weapon rules supply a standard action and no attack roll.

A Mephling casts spells with its ancestry’s matching elemental descriptor at +1 caster level. Common and its matching elemental language are automatic. Bonus languages are Aquan, Auran, Ignan, and Terran.
Air. +2 Dexterity, fly 10 ft. (perfect), dust-and-grit breath deals piercing damage. Automatic Auran. Favored class Bard.
Earth. +2 Strength and −2 Dexterity, burrow 10 ft., rock-shard breath deals bludgeoning damage. Automatic Terran. Favored class Druid.
Fire. +2 Dexterity, no additional movement mode, flame breath deals fire damage. Automatic Ignan. Favored class Sorcerer.
Water. +2 Constitution, swim 30 ft., caustic breath deals acid damage. Automatic Aquan. Favored class Monk. The traits give no water breathing.
LA +1, no racial Hit Dice. The sidebar mentions reduced fast healing but supplies no rate or conditions, and the playable traits give no fast healing ability.

npcBuilds.name: Pip Reedwhistle

build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
build.title: Air mephling bell loft guide, Bard 1
traits: Neutral good. Material Plane. Touch 14, flat-footed 14. Studded leather armor +3, Dexterity +3, size +1. Armor check penalty −1. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +1, Reflex +5, Will +2.
Bardic music 1/day. Inspire courage adds +1 morale on attack and weapon damage rolls and on saves against charm and fear. Allies must hear the performance.
Bardic knowledge +1. Bard can cast Bard spells in light armor without arcane spell failure. Matching air spells gain +1 caster level. None of these cantrips have the Air descriptor.
actions: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of dust and grit (piercing), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 11 half. No attack roll.
Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft. Within 30 ft. Point Blank Shot gives +5 to hit for 1d6+1.
Bard cantrips, CL 1, two casts per day. Detect magic, ghost sound (Will DC 13 if interacted with), light, and message.
build.tactics: Pip flies up through the bell loft’s broken hatch, signals the party with his flute, and guides them across the narrow gallery. If a creature blocks the exit, he waits for his allies to clear the cone before using his breath.

npcBuilds.role: Air mephling bell loft guide and Bard.
npcBuilds.motive: Get the party past a collapsed stair.
npcBuilds.hook: Pip can fly through the hatch and mark the safe route.

npcBuilds.name: Flint Cutwall

build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
build.title: Earth mephling cutwall digger, Druid 1
traits: Neutral good. Material Plane. Leather armor +2, heavy wooden shield +2, size +1. Touch 11, flat-footed 15. Armor check penalty −2 with the shield. BAB +0, grapple −1. Fortitude +4, Reflex +0, Will +5.

Nature sense adds +2 to Knowledge (nature) and Survival. Wild empathy +1. Combat Casting adds +4 to Concentration when casting defensively or while grappled or pinned. This encounter starts with no animal companion present.
Matching earth spells gain +1 caster level. None of the prepared spells listed have the Earth descriptor.
actions: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of rock shards and pebbles (bludgeoning), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 12 half. No attack roll.
Small club +4 melee, 1d4+3 bludgeoning, critical ×2.
Druid spells prepared, CL 1. Cantrips are create water, guidance, and light. First level spells are cure light wounds (1d8+1) and entangle (Reflex DC 14, lasts 1 minute and needs vegetation).
build.tactics: Flint digs around a blocked root cellar through loose earth. If an attacker follows outside, he uses entangle where roots and weeds grow, then gives the party room to pass.

npcBuilds.role: Earth mephling cutwall digger and Druid.
npcBuilds.motive: Find a way to the trapped cellar keeper.
npcBuilds.hook: Flint has found a stretch of loose earth beside the fallen wall.

npcBuilds.name: Cinder Kilnwatch

build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
build.title: Fire mephling kiln watch, Sorcerer 1
traits: Neutral. Material Plane. Touch 14, flat-footed 11. Unarmored, Dexterity +3, size +1. BAB +0, grapple −5. Fortitude +1, Reflex +3, Will +2. Improved Initiative adds +4 initiative.
Matching Fire spells gain +1 caster level. Burning hands is CL 2. Mage armor is CL 1 and adds +4 armor for 1 hour. With mage armor AC is 18, touch 14, flat-footed 15.
actions: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of flame (fire), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 11 half. No attack roll.
Small light crossbow +4 ranged, 1d6 piercing, critical 19–20/×2, range increment 80 ft.

Sorcerer spells known, five cantrip casts and four first-level casts per day. Cantrips at CL 1 are detect magic, light, mage hand, and prestidigitation. First-level spells are mage armor and burning hands (15-ft. cone, 2d4 fire, Reflex DC 14 half).
build.tactics: Cinder watches an old kiln passage. If warned, she puts up mage armor and uses the bend to avoid catching the kiln hands in either cone. Track her breath and spell uses separately.

npcBuilds.role: Fire mephling kiln watch and Sorcerer.
npcBuilds.motive: Keep the kiln hands from being cut off.
npcBuilds.hook: Cinder knows which passage bypasses the damaged flue.

npcBuilds.name: Ripple Lockreach

build.difficulty: Provisional CR 2. ECL 2 (1 class HD, LA +1).
build.title: Water mephling sluice rescuer, Monk 1
traits: Lawful good. Material Plane. Unarmored, size +1, Dexterity +2, Wisdom +2. Touch 15, flat-footed 13. BAB +0, grapple −2. Fortitude +5, Reflex +4, Will +4. Alertness adds +2 Listen and Spot.
Swim speed grants +8 racial on Swim checks for hazards or special actions, and permits taking 10 even under pressure. She still needs to breathe air.

Improved Unarmed Strike and Stunning Fist are Monk bonus feats. Stunning Fist is 1/day, declared before the attack roll. On a damaging hit the target must pass Fortitude DC 12 or be stunned for one round.
actions: Breath Weapon (Su), 1/day. Standard action, 15-ft. cone of caustic liquid (acid), 1d8 damage, Reflex DC 13 half. No attack roll.
Small Monk unarmed strike +3 melee, 1d4+2 bludgeoning, critical ×2. Unarmed flurry +1/+1 on a full attack, 1d4+2 each.
build.tactics: Ripple swims a rope to the sluice ladder, surfaces, then helps the party guide workers onto the dry ledge. She saves the caustic breath for a clear cone on land.

npcBuilds.role: Water mephling sluice rescuer and Monk.
npcBuilds.motive: Get a rope across the flooded sluice.
npcBuilds.hook: Ripple can reach the far ladder and signal when the line is ready.
